questions.question: Seven people H, I, J, K, W, Y and Z are sitting in a row facing north. Only three people sit between H and W. K sits to the immediate left of W. No one sits to the right of I. • Only two people sit between I and K.

questions.question:
In a certain code language, "SFOR" is coded as "116" and "WILA" is coded as "90".

What is the code for "GMVC" in that given language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is.

Logic: The code for a word is determined by summing the positional values of its letters and then multiplying the sum by 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5b7fb92fe463f426dda16450480763cf97c289393c570a891587d459e22ca45.png] 

**For SFOR **

 
• Sum of positional values = 19 + 6 + 15 + 18 = 58
 
• Code = 58 × 2 = 116

 

**For WILA, **

 
• Sum of positional values = 23 + 9 + 12 + 1 = 45
 
• Code = 45 × 2 = 90

 

**For GMVC:**

 
• Sum of positional values = 7 + 13 + 22 + 3 = 45
 
• Code = 45 × 2 = 90

 

Hence, the correct answer is "**option 1"**

⇒ (5 × 3) + 1

⇒ 15 + 1 = 16.

For the second set **(6, 3, 19)**

⇒ (6 × 3) + 1

⇒ 18 + 1 = 19.

Applying the same logic to **Option 3**

**(1, 7, 8)**

⇒ (1 × 7) + 1

⇒ 7 + 1 = 8.
